name: FDS9435A
title: 30 V P-channel PowerTrench MOSFET in SO-8
summary: A single P-channel enhancement MOSFET rated -30 V and -5.3 A continuous, a rugged-gate version built on the PowerTrench trench process. The gate is rated ±25 V and the part is specified for gate drive from 4.5 V to 25 V. On-resistance is 50 mΩ max with 10 V of gate drive and 80 mΩ max with 4.5 V. Gate charge is 10 nC typical. Uses named for it are power management, load switching and battery protection.

operation.text: This is a rugged-gate version of the part, specified for gate drive from 4.5 V up to 25 V, with a gate-source rating of ±25 V. On-resistance limits are given at VGS = -10 V and -4.5 V.

Junction-to-ambient resistance is 50 °C/W on a 1 in² pad of 2 oz copper, 105 °C/W on a 0.04 in² pad of 2 oz copper and 125 °C/W on the minimum pad. The single-operation dissipation ratings for those three mountings are 2.5 W, 1.2 W and 1 W; the -5.3 A continuous drain current is rated on the 1 in² pad.
The intrinsic source-drain diode carries up to -2.1 A continuously, with -1.2 V max forward drop at that current.
